Scope: the improvement ledger (precision and recall against reviewer labels), what separates peers from non-peers
(the trait X-learner), and valuation error reported once, as context.

Facts available:

- `f.ledger_cohort` = `{python} f.ledger_cohort`: label set the ledger facts are scored on
- `f.ledger_pairs` = `{python} f.ledger_pairs`: labelled pairs in that set
- `f.ledger_targets` = `{python} f.ledger_targets`: labelled targets in that set
- `f.ledger_b3_peer_precision` = `{python} f.ledger_b3_peer_precision`, `f.ledger_b3_peer_recall` = `{python} f.ledger_b3_peer_recall`: B3 list, any peer, precision / recall (target means)
- `f.ledger_b3_direct_precision` = `{python} f.ledger_b3_direct_precision`, `f.ledger_b3_direct_recall` = `{python} f.ledger_b3_direct_recall`: B3 list, direct peer
- `f.ledger_selector_peer_precision` = `{python} f.ledger_selector_peer_precision`, `f.ledger_selector_peer_recall` = `{python} f.ledger_selector_peer_recall`: selector, any peer
- `f.ledger_selector_direct_precision` = `{python} f.ledger_selector_direct_precision`, `f.ledger_selector_direct_recall` = `{python} f.ledger_selector_direct_recall`: selector, direct peer
- `f.ledger_agent_ge1_peer_precision` = `{python} f.ledger_agent_ge1_peer_precision`, `f.ledger_agent_ge1_peer_recall` = `{python} f.ledger_agent_ge1_peer_recall`: agent grade ≥ 1, any peer
- `f.ledger_agent_ge1_direct_precision` = `{python} f.ledger_agent_ge1_direct_precision`, `f.ledger_agent_ge1_direct_recall` = `{python} f.ledger_agent_ge1_direct_recall`: agent grade ≥ 1, direct peer
- `f.ledger_agent_2_peer_precision` = `{python} f.ledger_agent_2_peer_precision`, `f.ledger_agent_2_peer_recall` = `{python} f.ledger_agent_2_peer_recall`: agent grade 2, any peer
- `f.ledger_agent_2_direct_precision` = `{python} f.ledger_agent_2_direct_precision`, `f.ledger_agent_2_direct_recall` = `{python} f.ledger_agent_2_direct_recall`: agent grade 2, direct peer
- `f.trait_large_customers_direct` = `{python} f.trait_large_customers_direct` (`f.trait_large_customers_direct_ci` = `{python} f.trait_large_customers_direct_ci`): large customers, direct-peer lift (95% interval), round 1
- `f.trait_large_customers_peer` = `{python} f.trait_large_customers_peer` (`f.trait_large_customers_peer_ci` = `{python} f.trait_large_customers_peer_ci`): large customers, peer lift, round 1
- `f.trait_large_customers_findings` = `{python} f.trait_large_customers_findings`: large customers, tests that are findings (BH q ≤ 0.10)
- `f.trait_mission_critical_direct` = `{python} f.trait_mission_critical_direct` (`f.trait_mission_critical_direct_ci` = `{python} f.trait_mission_critical_direct_ci`): mission-critical, direct-peer lift, round 2
- `f.trait_mission_critical_peer` = `{python} f.trait_mission_critical_peer` (`f.trait_mission_critical_peer_ci` = `{python} f.trait_mission_critical_peer_ci`): mission-critical, peer lift, round 2
- `f.trait_mission_critical_findings` = `{python} f.trait_mission_critical_findings`: mission-critical, tests that are findings
- `f.trait_r1_findings` = `{python} f.trait_r1_findings`: round 1, findings of all tests
- `f.trait_r2_findings` = `{python} f.trait_r2_findings`: round 2, findings of all tests
- `f.trait_r2_unsupported` = `{python} f.trait_r2_unsupported`: round 2 traits too rare to estimate
- `f.val_targets` = `{python} f.val_targets`: training targets where the selector kept a comp (valuation compared on these)
- `f.val_err_no_matching` = `{python} f.val_err_no_matching`: no matching, median absolute % error of EV/EBITDA, those targets
- `f.val_err_b3` = `{python} f.val_err_b3`: B3 list median, same targets
- `f.val_err_selector` = `{python} f.val_err_selector`: selector-kept comps median, same targets
- `f.val_gain_selector` = `{python} f.val_gain_selector` (`f.val_gain_selector_ci` = `{python} f.val_gain_selector_ci`): selector's gain on no matching (95% interval)
- `f.val_training_targets` = `{python} f.val_training_targets`: all training targets
- `f.val_err_no_matching_all` = `{python} f.val_err_no_matching_all`: no matching on all training targets

Figures available: @tbl-ledger (the ledger), @fig-progress (precision and recall per ledger row), @fig-trait-lift-r1
